description: This file defines extension methods for ContentElement and IContent types in the OrchardCore.ContentManagement namespace, providing utilities for managing content elements, including get, set, remove, weld, apply, and type filtering functionalities.

classes.name: ContentExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ContentElement and IContent for content management operations.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a content element by type and name, with type safety.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if a content element has a specific element attached.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a content element by its type and name, returning null if not found.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a content element by its name.

methods.name: GetOrCreate
methods.description: Gets an existing content element by name or creates a new one.

methods.name: Weld
methods.description: Adds or welds a content element by name.

methods.name: Weld
methods.description: Welds a new part of specified type to the content item, with optional settings.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Updates a content element with another content element.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Updates the content element with the specified name with another content element.

methods.name: Alter
methods.description: Modifies or creates a content element by name using an action.

methods.name: AlterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously modifies or creates a content element by name using an async action.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Updates the content item data with a content part.

methods.name: IsPublished
methods.description: Checks if the content is published.

methods.name: HasDraft
methods.description: Checks if the content has a draft.

methods.name: OfType
methods.description: Enumerates all content elements of a specific type.
